name: Kawaii Mono Ijime
source:
The player becomes a girl and ends up bullying her underclassmen. They are made to scrub the floor while completely naked, made to relieve themselves in a boys' urinal, made to play in an open-air swimming pool wearing nothing, spanked, and subjected to all sorts of other oppression.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031570.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
